# MIFECO SaaS Referral Program

## Program Overview
The MIFECO SaaS Referral Program incentivizes existing clients and partners to refer new business to our LaunchPad, Transformation, and Enterprise SaaS offerings. This program leverages trusted relationships to acquire high-quality leads while rewarding our advocates.

## Incentive Structure

### For Existing Clients
- **Referral Reward**: $500 account credit for each qualified referral that becomes a paying client
- **Tier Bonus**: Additional
